name: Skeljaskrímsli
body:
SKELJASKRÍMSLI
CR 7

This hulking beast is covered with overlapping dark blue armor plates covering almost its entire body, to the clubbed knob at the tip of its tail. Its paws and jaws are covered in thick gray fur, and its beady red eyes are barely visible.

XP 3,200
N Large magical beast (aquatic)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 10, flat-footed 19 (+1 Dex, +10 natural, –1 size)
hp 92 (9d10+45)
Fort +11, Ref +7, Will +7
Defensive Abilities poisonous blood; Resist fire 10
DR 5/silver, 10/slashing

OFFENSE

Speed 25 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +16 (1d8+6/19–20), tail slap +11 (2d6+9)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (20-ft. cone, 6d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 19 Reflex half, usable every 1d4 rounds), poison, rend (2 claws, 1d8+9)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 12, Con 21, Int 2, Wis 18, Cha 10
Base Atk +9; CMB +16; CMD 27 (31 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance, Improved Critical (claw), Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Perception +15, Swim +18
SQ amphibious

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Ex)

Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a skeljaskrímsli can breathe a 20-foot cone of choking smoke, dealing 6d6 points of fire damage to all creatures struck (Reflex DC 19 halves). This smoke then makes the area totally concealed for 1 round after the skeljaskrímsli creates it. Creatures in the area of effect or that enter the area are exposed to the skeljaskrímsli’s poison. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Poison (Ex)

Poisonous blood or breath weapon—contact; save Fort DC 19; frequency 1/round for 10 rounds; effect 1 Con damage and 1d3 Dex damage; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Poisonous Blood (Ex)

When the skeljaskrímsli takes piercing or slashing damage, its poisonous blood sprays on its attacker and any creatures adjacent to both the creature and the attacker, exposing each of them to skeljaskrímsli poison. It can’t spray blood again for 1d4 rounds.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold coastlines or plains
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure incidental

Skeljaskrímslis are amphibious creatures that spend most of their time in the sea. When the weather grows intense, especially in the winter, they sometimes come ashore or roam into freshwater for a time to feed. Light attracts these creatures.

The creature’s entire quadrupedal body is protected by thick, layered shells like those of shellfish that gleam and shine as it moves. A skeljaskrímsli’s legs are stout and round like a pachyderm, with long claws. Its mouth and eyes glow red when it is agitated. The average adult skeljaskrímsli is about 11 feet long and weighs around 8,000 pounds.
